## Instacart Shopping Dashboard

I created an interactive dashboard to explore online grocery shopping patterns using the Instacart dataset.

The dashboard includes three visualizations:

- A bar chart comparing purchased item counts across departments.
- A line chart showing reorder rates by hour of day.
- A box plot comparing add-to-cart positions across four departments, using a random sample of 500 items per department.

The produce department has the highest purchased item count among the departments displayed. Reorder rates are also relatively high during the early morning hours.
